title: dfilter: Replace macro UAT config file and update GUI
description:
Remove the UAT macro usage. The UAT API is nifty for dissectors
but clunky for everything else.

This allows using a hash table to store macros, that is the natural
data structure for the use case (and faster).

It also allows using the existing filter GUI dialog, adapted for
display filter macros. The difference isn't huge but it's better
and less limited than the more generic UAT dialog, with room for
improvement. Changing the UAT dialog for filter specific
use cases is difficult.

The config file is renamed to "dmacros" and uses the same format
as "dfilter", that is more amenable and forgiving for hand-editing
than the UAT storage format.

There is some logic to convert the "dfilter_macros" UAT config
file to a "dmacros" filter config file, for backward-compatibility.
The conversion is only done if there is no existing "dmacros" file
in the profile folder.

This broke handling `dfilter_macros` in profiles.

1. Switch to a profile which contains a `dfilter_macros` file (in the old format) and open the "Display Filter Macros..." dialog. Only the default macros are found, not the macros in the profile.
2. If I press `OK` the new `dmacros` file are stored without the profile macros. The profile macros are lost.
3. If I press `Cancel` and restart Wireshark the profile macros are merged with the default macros. Now the default macros must be manually deleted.
4. The old `dfilters_macros` file does still exist after converting to the new `dmacros` file, making it hard to understand where the macros are stored.

I would expect only the macros in the profile to be used, and not merged with the default.

Thanks, I'll take a look.

I considered removing the `dfilter_macros` file but decided it was better to keep it. Maybe it could be renamed to `dfilter_macros~`.
I often switch between the latest released version and a development version for various use cases, so maybe keeping the old file is ok when knowing what happens.

Another regression issue is that the "Copy from <profile>" button is missing in the dialog. Now it's not possible to copy macros between profiles.

Also, it's not possible to delete all entries in one click.

I'll grant you that is a regression but neither does the "Display Filter" dialog have that.

I don't see a use-case for profiles with saved filters/macros. Seems like a misfeature to me. The only possible reason I could see is to use the same name to mean different things in different profiles and that just seems confusing.

It's a use-case for profiles when you get a profile during training, I have seen this being done during SharkFest. But I do agree it's not really suited for profiles, the macros should be available in all profiles.

 * Display filter autocompletions now also include display filter functions.
 
+* The display filter macro configuration file has changed format. It now uses
+  the same format as the "dfilters" file and has been renamed accordingly to
+  "dmacros". Internally it no longer uses the UAT API and the display filter macro

+  but it is advisable to check that the "dfilter_macros" (old) and
+  "dmacros" (new) files in the profile directory are consistent.
